name: Stride - v1.0.17 - Growth
body:
# Stride v1.0.17 — Growth

A new Explore page, challenges with friends, and Stride in six more languages.

## New

- **Explore Stride.** History → **Explore Stride** brings the new pages together:
  - **Stride Wrapped 2026**: swipe through your total steps, best day, longest
    streak, top month and distance, then share a free recap card.
  - **Virtual journeys**: turn everyday distance into progress along the
    Marathon trail, the Camino from Sarria or Mumbai to Delhi.
  - **Adaptive goal**: a daily goal suggestion based on your last two weeks.
- **Friends challenges.** Create or join a private seven-day challenge with an
  invite link or code, no account needed. Each member chooses when to share
  their daily totals; routes and other health data stay on your phone. When the
  first invited friend shares a day with 1,000+ steps, they and the host each
  get a bonus streak freeze.
- **Bring your step history.** Moving from another counter? Fill missing days
  from Health Connect, up to a year back where your phone allows it. Days you
  already have keep their counts.
- **Quick Settings tile** with today's steps: add it from Android's Quick
  Settings editor.
- **Six more languages.** Stride is now fully translated into Indonesian,
  Turkish, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu and Japanese, and every new screen is
  translated in all 13 languages.
- **Step recovery** in Settings → Data keeps recent count corrections, also in
  JSON backups, and refunds a streak freeze when you restore a goal day.
- **Wear OS (first version).** A separate watch app counts your watch's steps
  and adds a tile and a watch-face complication.

## Fixed

- Compact circular widgets fit the full count.
- History opens on the current week.
- Today's phone count is kept after a backup restore or a day-start change.

## Stride is on Google Play

Bought Premium on **Gumroad or Polar**? Swap your licence key for a free
Google Play code at **https://stride-move.narzo9990.workers.dev**, then back
up (Settings → Export backup), uninstall this version, install Stride from
Google Play, and restore (Settings → Import backup):
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vythera.stride

Help: https://t.me/vythera_apps

## Download

Install **Stride-1.0.17-Growth.apk** below. It updates v1.0.16 in place and
keeps your history. Premium in this build still unlocks with your Gumroad or
Polar licence key.

**Stride-1.0.17-WearOS.apk** is the watch app, for Wear OS 3 or later.
Sideload it onto the watch (for example with adb over Wi-Fi), open it once and
allow step access, then add the Stride tile or complication.

name: Stride - v1.0.16 - Feedback Loop
body:
# Stride v1.0.16 — Feedback Loop

Fixes from the new feedback inbox, and a better way to send me more.

## New

- **Feedback in the app.** Settings → Help & feedback → **Feedback**: Report a
  bug, Request a feature, Send a message or Rate Stride. Each opens the Vythera
  feedback page in your browser with your Stride version and phone already
  filled in, and you can attach screenshots or logs. Nothing is sent until you
  submit the form.
- **Crash logs.** If Stride ever crashes, it saves a log on your phone and, on
  Android 10 and later, in **Downloads › Stride**. Next time you open Stride it
  offers to report the bug or share the log. The log has Stride's version, your
  phone and Android version, the error and Stride's own settings; nothing
  personal, and it never leaves your phone unless you send it. Turn it off in
  Settings → Help & feedback → Save crash logs.
- **Best day on Awards**, next to Lifetime: your best day ever, with its date,
  distance, calories and active minutes.

## Fixed

- **Home's streak stopped at 8** while Awards showed the real one
  ([#9](https://github.com/NikhilKain/stride/issues/9)). Both now count the
  whole history, streak freezes included, and update when the day changes.
- **The 7-day average in Verdant** no longer gets cut off ("24,18…") in a wide
  font.

Google Play code at **https://stride-move.narzo9990.workers.dev**, then back

name: Stride - v1.0.15 - Milestone
body:
# Stride v1.0.15 — Milestone

Fixes reported by the Stride community and on GitHub.

## Fixed

- **Awards follow Miles** ([#8](https://github.com/NikhilKain/stride/issues/8)).
  With Miles on, Marathon Club reads 26.2 mi, the 100, 500 and 1,000 km awards
  62.1, 311 and 621 mi, and the monthly distance challenge is 62.1 mi with
  progress in miles. The distances needed are unchanged.
- **Square share card.** The percentage, stat chips, caption and wordmark no
  longer overlap on the square shape, with or without your photo.
- **Settings going blank on a fast scroll.** Cards now make their entrance only
  as a page opens.
- **Home's buttons in long languages.** Each button gets an equal share of the
  row and its label shrinks to fit ("Synchronisieren" and "Auszeichnungen" ran
  into each other in German).
- **Lock screen glance setting.** "While walking" no longer comes out in tiny
  type.
- **Update check frequency** no longer cuts the last choice off at the edge.

## New

- **Stride island in landscape** (Premium; Settings → Tracking → Show in
  landscape, off by default). Off, the island steps aside while the phone is
  sideways, as for a video or a game; on, it sits at the top centre.
- **Anonymous usage count.** Tells me how many phones use Stride: a hashed device code, random installation and session
  codes, how long the app is open, phone model, Android and app version, and
  country. Never steps, health data, routes or location, and it can't switch the
  app off. Details in the
  [privacy policy](https://nikhilkain.github.io/stride/privacy-policy.html).
- **Fully translated** into German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Russian, Hindi
  and Arabic, including onboarding and the Google Play banner.

# Stride v1.0.14 — Snapshot

Requests and reports from the Stride community: share cards with your own
photo, your steps on the lock screen, and widgets that follow your wallpaper.

## New

- **Share with your own photo (Premium).** In the Share studio (Home → Share), take a
  photo or pick one and your steps, percentage of goal, distance, active
  minutes and calories go over it. An opened walk or run has **With photo**
  too, with its distance and time large. No camera or storage permission is
  needed.
- **Lock screen glance** (free; Settings → Tracking, off by default). Today's
  steps, goal, distance, active minutes and calories on a black screen over
  your lock screen, so you can check them without unlocking. Choose **While
  walking** or **Always**. Swipe up to unlock as usual, or tap **Show lock
  screen** for your notifications. It needs "Display over other apps".
- **Live preview in the Share studio (Premium).** The card is shown as you build it, so
  what you share is what you saw.

## Changed

- **Widgets follow Wallpaper colors.** With Settings → Appearance → Wallpaper
  colors on, every widget design takes your wallpaper's Material You colours
  and redraws when the wallpaper or dark mode changes.
- **History under Liquid glass.** Its cards and Week / Month buttons are glass
  like the rest of the app, in Classic and Verdant.
- **Awards challenges** fill with Material 3 Expressive's wavy bar.

## Fixed

- **Status bar icons in a light theme.** Since 1.0.12 the clock and icons
  stayed white over a light theme on Android 12 and later.
- **The count crowding the ring at goal (Classic).** The number now fits the
  space the wave leaves clear.
- **The ring around Walk in Verdant's bar.** The selection tile now docks
  under the button, which squares off while Walk is open.
- Home's distance, calories and active-minute tiles no longer overflow in a
  wide font.

body:
# Stride v1.0.12 — Daybreak

Ideas from the Stride community on Telegram: choose when your day starts,
lifetime stats, auto-pause, glass widgets and a new Retro skin.

## Stride is on Google Play

If you bought Premium on **Gumroad or Polar**, you don't pay again. Swap your
licence key for a free Google Play code at
**https://stride-move.narzo9990.workers.dev**.

The Play version can't install over this one, so the move takes a minute:

1. **Get your Play code** on the website. Each key can be swapped once, and your
   key keeps working in this version.
2. **Back up**: Settings → Export backup.
3. **Uninstall** this version, then **install Stride from Google Play**:
   https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vythera.stride
4. **Restore**: Settings → Import backup. Redeem your code and Premium unlocks
   by itself, or tap Restore purchase.

The Home banner, Settings → Premium → Move to Google Play and the reminder
every 4 days (switch it off on the notification or under Settings → Premium →
Play Store reminders) all walk you through it.

## New

- **Choose when your day starts.** Settings → Goals → Day starts at: midnight
  or any hour up to 6 am, so a late night out no longer counts towards
  tomorrow or breaks your streak.
- **Lifetime stats** on Awards: every step, kilometre and active day since your
  first step, plus four new milestone badges.
- **Personal best on Home**, and a "New record!" notification when today
  beats it.
- **Auto-pause.** The walk clock stops after about 12 seconds standing still
  and starts again when you move off.
- **Walks and runs:** share or save one as a picture, export it as **GPX** for
  Strava or Komoot, or save it to **Health Connect** with its route.
- **Your own quotes** for the Home card and the goal notifications.
- **What's new** sheet after each update.
- **Premium:** month recap picture, spoken updates every kilometre or mile, and
  **glass widgets** that sit on your wallpaper like liquid glass.

## Changed

- **Retro is now the Pocket walk club:** a pocket step-counter toy on Home,
  with its own cream, ink, teal and coral colours.
- **Launch animation:** your app icon drops in and a liquid ripple spreads
  across the app.
- **Glass nav bar** switch for Classic and Verdant, for a plain solid bar.
- Simpler step settings, snappier tab switching, and the Expressive loader for
  pull to refresh.
- Tapping the Premium status in Settings goes straight to buying.
- Support links now go to https://t.me/vythera_apps.

## Fixes

- Walk steps come straight from the phone's step counter, so with Health
  Connect as your step source, a walk no longer pauses and resumes by itself.

## Download

Install **Stride-1.0.12-Daybreak.apk** below. It updates v1.0.11 in place and
keeps your history. Premium in this build still unlocks with your Gumroad or
Polar licence key.

name: Stride - v1.0.10 - Looking Glass
body:
# Stride v1.0.10 — Looking Glass

This release covers everything since v1.0.8 (1.0.9 and 1.0.10). The headline is
accuracy: Stride now counts from your watch when you wear one, never adds two
sources together, and filters bus, car and auto rides on the default Health
Connect source too. It also brings a big visual update.

## More accurate step counts

### Watch first, never doubled
Under **Health Connect** the default is **Automatic** again:

- On days your watch or band has synced steps, Stride counts from the watch.
- Otherwise it counts from this phone's own built-in counter.
- The two are **never added together.** Health Connect only removes duplicates
  when records line up exactly, so a walk the phone and the watch both logged
  used to be counted twice.

Automatic used to combine every app on days without watch data. Now it reads
only the phone's counter, and all apps only on phones that keep no count of
their own. If you picked a source by hand, it is kept. You can still choose any
single app under **Settings → Step source → Count steps from**.

### Accurate step filtering now works everywhere
Phones count road vibration as walking. The filter used to act only on the live
phone pedometer, so with the default source (the phone's counter in Health
Connect) every ride still added steps. Now:

- **Detected rides are saved,** and the phone's Health Connect steps recorded
  inside them are taken off. Watch steps are left alone.
- **Steps are judged by when they happened, not when they arrived.** With the
  screen off, the phone delivers steps in batches, often after the ride has
  ended. Those batches are now filtered too.
- **Rides are dated from their first vehicle reading,** and a ride survives a
  few minutes of silence from activity detection instead of ending and needing
  to be confirmed again.
- **The detector no longer stays off for good** if Physical activity was
  granted after Stride started; it retries every minute until it runs.

Tested on a Pixel 6a with a CMF watch: Automatic matched the watch exactly, and
a one-hour test ride removed exactly the steps the phone recorded in that hour.

## One place to choose where steps come from

**Settings → Step source** now holds both choices: Health Connect or This phone,
and under Health Connect which app to count from. The Step sources screen
(Help → *Why is my count different?*) is read-only diagnostics showing what
each app reported today.

## New look

- **Liquid glass navigation bar** in every theme, with a clear glass tile that
  slides to the selected tab.
- **Liquid glass for Classic and Verdant** (Premium): cards become frosted glass
  over a soft wallpaper, or your own photo.
- **Six app icons:** the original plus Aurora, Ember, Lagoon, Cobalt and Blossom,
  used on the home screen, in the app drawer and on the splash screen.
- **Rolling numbers,** a full-screen badge celebration, springy nav icons,
  bouncy scrolling and Pixel-style predictive back.
- **Walk is a tab** like the others.

## Also new

- **Height and weight units:** cm or ft · in, kg or lb, switchable right in the
  Height and Weight dialogs and during setup.
- **Widget font and weight:** widgets now use Stride's fonts, from Light to Heavy.
- **Live Updates** show the step count in the status-bar chip, and the
  notification reads "710 to go · 2,000 goal".

## Fixes

- Liquid glass: unreadable text on inverted cards (Premium unlocked, the Awards
  streak, "Keep going!"), most visible with the Monochrome style.
- "Use the sensor instead" during setup is now saved.
- Smoother opening of Home and History; flicks no longer stop dead after a bounce.
- The nav bar fits narrow screens and large text.

## Download

Install **Stride-1.0.10-Looking-Glass.apk** below. It updates v1.0.8 and v1.0.9 in
place and keeps your history. Premium in this build still unlocks with your
Gumroad or Polar licence key.

Stride is also coming to **Google Play**. To help test it, join
https://groups.google.com/g/testers-community, then open
https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.vythera.stride and tap
**Become a tester**.

name: Stride - v1.0.8 - Kinetic Flow
body:
Step-counter fixes, simpler settings and a widget pack

This release fixes how Stride handles phone sensor readings, Health Connect
corrections and vehicle filtering. It also simplifies the step-source settings
and fixes navigation and walk-screen usability.

## Five widget choices

The existing **Adaptive** widget is joined by four new designs:

- **Pocket:** a compact dark tile with a mint walking icon, large step count and
  distance underneath.
- **Orbit:** a circular goal-progress display with the step count in the centre.
- **Daily:** a light card with steps, goal progress, distance and calories.
- **Week:** a dark seven-day chart with today highlighted.

Long-press your home screen → **Widgets → Stride** to add them. Each design is a
separate entry, so you can place several at once and resize them. The widgets use
Stride’s saved counts and distance units; tapping one opens the app. Goal and unit
changes refresh the pack too. The Adaptive widget’s progress-bar rendering is fixed.
The widget pack is free, matching the existing widget’s availability.

## A clearer choice of step source

There are now two choices: **Health Connect** and **This phone**.

Health Connect is the default. It continues to prefer synced watch/band data
when available; otherwise it uses the external Health Connect total. Stride's
own pedometer runs only after you select **This phone**. It no longer takes over
silently when Health Connect is unavailable.

The selected source now determines today's total without an older, higher phone
count holding it up. A sync or a source change can legitimately lower the number.
If you choose a particular app in **Step sources**, Stride follows only that app,
including zero until it has synced steps.

## Counter and vehicle-filter fixes

- Ignore duplicate and out-of-order phone sensor readings instead of letting them
  corrupt the next step difference.
- Use sensor event timestamps and boot identity when handling delayed readings,
  day boundaries and reboots.
- Apply vehicle filtering to fresh sensor intervals within a confirmed ride.
  Walking clears the ride state immediately; stale evidence expires. A fresh
  still report can maintain a confirmed ride, such as when stopped in traffic.
- Stop applying the phone's vehicle state to Health Connect imports. Steps synced
  during a commute may have been walked earlier.
- Read steps even when optional distance/calorie permissions are declined, and
  scan all Health Connect record pages when discovering source apps.
- Retain the last saved count on Health Connect read errors. Avoid unrestricted
  hourly reads when no eligible external source exists.

These changes address counting and source-selection bugs. They do not guarantee
that different devices will measure exactly the same number of steps.

## Defaults and a reset button

New installations use **Health Connect**, **vehicle filtering on**, and
**write steps back off**. Existing explicit settings are preserved; old
Automatic source selections migrate to Health Connect.

To apply these defaults to an existing installation, open
**Settings → Reset step settings**. This also clears a manually selected source
app. History, goals and Premium remain intact, and previously exported Health
Connect records are not deleted.

Vehicle filtering applies only to Stride's phone counter and requires background
tracking and the activity permission. Watch data still needs to sync from the
companion app into Health Connect; pairing over Bluetooth alone is not enough.

## UI fixes

- Removed repeated screen/card entrance animations and temporary theme changes
  when switching tabs; tapping the current tab no longer reloads it.
- Reserved space above the bottom navigation so it does not cover screen content.
- Made the walk screen scroll as one list, with reachable Start/Stop controls.
- Added a map overview before a location fix, clearer location status and
  permission guidance, and centering when the first fix arrives.
- Allowed longer achievement names to wrap.

Classic, Retro and Verdant remain. The experimental Trail preview is not part of
this release. Premium billing, licensing and existing feature access are unchanged.

## Download and verification

Attach **`Stride-1.0.8-widget-pack.apk`** to this release. Install over the
existing direct edition without uninstalling or clearing data.

- Android 8.0 or newer; package `com.vythera.stride`.
- Version `1.0.8-direct`, version code `9`.
- Offline release build and release lint checks passed; all **28 unit tests passed**.
- APK signature verified; installed over the existing app on the connected phone.
- Five widget providers verified; Pocket and Orbit tested together in the launcher.
- The new layouts were checked at normal/minimum sizes, long/zero counts and 1.3×
  text scaling. Debug-only sample screens are absent from this release.
- SHA-256: `CA486AFCFD4F3EC922E3651923EBCD38EAA4B36AF08012BE5998BB13D6FEB0E6`.

For feedback, include your selected source, phone/watch model, companion app and
whether its data had synced. Comparing a short walk and a vehicle journey
separately is more useful than comparing all-day totals alone.

name: Stride v1.0.7 — True North
body:
**Please update if you wear a watch or a fitness band.** This release is almost
entirely about one question people kept asking in different words: *why does my
watch say one number and Stride another?* Several of you sent screenshots,
videos and side-by-side comparisons. Every fix below started with one of those.
Thank you.

## Your watch's steps count again

If you had **Write steps back** turned on, Stride could quietly ignore your
watch and show the phone's count instead. One report had the watch at 3,048 and
Stride at 1,397.

Health Connect doesn't simply add every app's steps together. Where two apps
cover the same stretch of time, it picks one by priority. Stride's own
write-back covered the whole day, so it often *won* — and when Stride then
removed its own share to avoid counting itself, there was almost nothing left.
With Health Connect apparently empty, Stride fell back to the phone.

Stride now reads the other apps by name instead of subtracting itself, so what
it reads no longer depends on whether it writes.

## No more counting the same walk twice

Recent Android phones — Pixels included — record steps into Health Connect on
their own, with no app installed. Wear a watch as well and the same walk arrives
twice: once from the watch, once from the phone. Health Connect only removes the
overlap where the two line up exactly, which they rarely do. One tester's watch
said 2,269, the phone 2,613, and Health Connect's combined total 7,024.

**On any day your watch has steps, Stride now counts the watch alone.** On days
without watch data, nothing changes.

- Stride recognises a watch from the data itself, and also knows the companion
  apps that only ever relay a watch or band: Nothing X, CMF Watch, Fitbit,
  Garmin Connect, Zepp, Zepp Life, Mi Fitness, Oura, Whoop and Polar Flow.
- **Your number may drop once after updating** — today's to the watch's figure,
  and past days recalculated the same way. That's the double counting coming out.
- Steps you take without the watch on don't count that day. If you'd rather have
  a particular app decide, see *Choose which app counts* below.

## See where your steps come from

- **A line under today's count** now names the source: *From Nothing X*,
  *From Health Connect · Samsung Health*, *Counted by this phone*. Tap it for
  the details.
- **New Step sources screen.** What Stride shows, what the phone counted, and
  Health Connect's combined total, side by side — then every app that wrote
  steps today with its own count, and whether Stride used it. Also reachable
  from Help and from Settings → Step source.
- **Choose which app counts.** *Count steps from* lets you pick one app — your
  watch, Samsung Health, anything that writes steps — and Stride follows only
  that app on days it has data. *Automatic* is the default.
- **A warning when Health Connect is ignoring an app.** An app has to be in
  Health Connect's *Data sources and priority* list to count, even with
  permission to write. If it isn't, its steps show up in Health Connect's
  entries and still add up to nothing — which looks exactly like Stride losing
  your watch. Stride now spots this, names the app, and tells you how to add it.

## Help, inside the app

A new **Help** screen in Settings answers the questions that come up most:
watch and phone disagreeing, a health app that never shared with Health
Connect, steps stopping while the screen is off, and more — each with the exact
screens to visit. Buttons open Health Connect, Stride's app settings page
(for battery and background permissions), and our Telegram group.

## Exact steps for every hour *(Premium)*

**Insights → Today by hour** now shows the exact count for each hour. Tap a bar,
or press and hold and slide across the day: the bar you're on grows and a bubble
shows its steps and time.

## Weekly summary, now for everyone

The Sunday-evening recap is free now, and it compares your week with the one
before: *"52,410 steps this week, 8% more than last week · best day 11,203"*.
Turn it off under Settings → Notifications → Weekly summary.

## Fixes

- **Accurate step filtering no longer eats watch steps.** A watch app delivers
  steps in batches whenever it syncs. If a batch landed during a ride — or at
  your desk after one, since sitting still never ends "in a vehicle" — the
  filter took hours of real walking for bus vibration. One day lost 410 steps.
  On watch days the filter now stays out of it; watches don't mistake engine
  vibration for steps the way a pocketed phone does. It still filters the
  phone's own count.
- **"Open Health Connect" works on Android 14 and newer.** The button in
  Settings did nothing on phones where Health Connect is built into the system.
- **Settings no longer shows an impossible Health Connect number.** The
  comparison line added up every record, and some apps re-save a growing total
  each time they sync — one person saw 44,643 on a day they walked about 2,300.
  It now shows Health Connect's own total.
- **The hourly chart matches the daily total**, reading the same apps.

## Worth knowing

- Stride can only show what your watch app has passed to Health Connect so far.
  Watch apps sync in batches, so during the day Stride may trail the watch's
  live number until the next sync. A finished day is the fair comparison.
- The new screens and messages are in English only for now. Translations follow.
